units.headline: New benchmark for filterSeriesAndSortPostings across input fractions
units.summary: Adds a benchmark that runs the filter step over 100k-series heads at several input fractions. It is test-only.
units.reason: New benchmark only; cannot change runtime behavior.

units.headline: staleIndex renamed to selectedSeriesIndex with renamed types
units.summary: Pure rename of an unexported method, its return type and its field. The body is otherwise identical, and the only caller (SelectedSeriesHead.Index) is updated.
units.reason: Rename of unexported identifiers with all uses updated; logic is identical.

units.headline: headStaleIndexReader renamed to headSelectedSeriesIndexReader
units.summary: Unexported struct and field renamed, and the comment updated. The struct is not serialized, so behavior is unchanged.
units.reason: Unexported in-memory type rename; not serialized, and all uses are updated.

units.summary: Only identifiers and the comment changed. The intersect logic is the same.
units.reason: Identifier rename only; same operations on the same data.

units.headline: staleSeriesRefs struct renamed to seriesRefs
units.summary: Unexported struct renamed and its fields unchanged. It is an in-memory type only.
units.reason: Unexported, non-serialized type rename with uses updated.

units.headline: Stale-series lookup generalized to filter arbitrary postings by predicate
units.summary: Turns the stale-only scan into a general helper that resolves refs from any postings and keeps those that pass an optional predicate checked under the series lock. It now gets caller-supplied ref lists through CompactSelectedSeries, so input order and uniqueness are no longer guaranteed.

issues.title: Duplicate input refs yield duplicate series in sortedByLabels
issues.evidence:
sortedByRef = append(sortedByRef, ref)
		keptSeries = append(keptSeries, s)
issues.failure_scenario: CompactSelectedSeries([]SeriesRef{r, r}) → sortedByLabels has r twice → the block index writer gets the same label set twice and may reject it as out of order, so the whole compaction fails.
issues.detail: Before this PR the input was always AllPostings, which is unique. Caller-supplied lists are not deduplicated or sorted, and the 'sortedByRef' name and the ListPostings wrapper assume sorted, unique refs.

units.reason: Core filtering used by the new compaction path, now fed arbitrary caller input.
focus: Unsorted or duplicate caller refs reaching ListPostings/sortedByRef and the index writer
Locking: keep runs under s.Lock; a nil keep reads no series state
Equivalence with the old stale filter (OOO check plus stale check under a single lock)

units.headline: Stale-ref collection now delegates to filterSeriesAndSortPostings
units.summary: Same logic as before: walk all postings and keep series with no OOO data that are stale, with both checks under the series lock. Only the not-found debug log text changes.
units.reason: Refactor that is visibly equivalent to the removed code; the predicate is the same and runs under the same lock.
